column2: A virtue acquired by long practice and the same virtue received as a gift are contraries of the same vice.
A calm produced by medication is as much the contrary of anxiety in that person at that time as a calm reached by meditation, if the two calms are the same condition.
An agent made to face the work of their own hand against their will is, while facing it, in the contrary of being turned away from it, as much as one who faces it freely.
